descriptionHtml:
ضمان عام من الوكيل

**Brand:** Rapoo

**Model:** 8000M

**Type:** Wireless Keyboard + Mouse Combo

**Connection:** Multi-mode (Bluetooth 3.0 / Bluetooth 5.0 / 2.4GHz Wireless)

**Number of Devices Supported:** Up to 3 devices (switch between them)

**Compatible Operating Systems:** Windows, macOS, Android, iOS


**Keyboard Specifications:**

**Keyboard Layout:** 99 keys (compact layout)

**Keyboard Type:** Scissor-switch (membrane)

**Keyboard Color:** Black 

**Connection Modes:** Bluetooth 3.0, Bluetooth 5.0, 2.4GHz (nano USB receiver)

**Battery Type:** 2 x AAA batteries (not included)

**Battery Life:** Up to 12 months (based on 2 hours daily use)

**Dimensions (Keyboard):** 342 x 137 x 24 mm

**Weight (Keyboard):** 320g (without batteries)


**Mouse Specifications:**

**Mouse Type:** Optical

**DPI Levels:** 1000 / 1300 / 1600 DPI (adjustable)

**Number of Buttons:** 3 buttons (left, right, scroll wheel)

**Connection Modes:** Bluetooth 3.0, Bluetooth 5.0, 2.4GHz (nano USB receiver)

**Battery Type:** 1 x AA battery (not included)

**Battery Life:** Up to 12 months (based on 2 hours daily use)

**Dimensions (Mouse):** 96 x 59 x 36 mm

**Weight (Mouse):** 65g (without battery)


**Wireless Specifications:**

**2.4GHz Wireless Range:** Up to 10 meters (33 feet)

**Bluetooth Wireless Range:** Up to 10 meters (33 feet)

**Nano USB Receiver:** Stored inside mouse compartment

**Receiver Dimensions:** 18 x 13 x 5 mm


**Features:**

Multi-mode connectivity (switch between 3 devices)

Low battery indicator (LED)

Plug and Play (no driver installation required)

Energy-saving design

Auto sleep mode (when idle)


**Package Includes:**

Rapoo 8000M keyboard

Rapoo 8000M mouse

Nano USB receiver (pre-stored in mouse)

User manual
